'''2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 Kevin Shannon LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2008 Texas Match Play Championship]] (Day 2). The printout's Player Name box is blank; the file name printed in its footer is <code>kevinls_day2.html</code>.

The sheet lists 60 cards and, under the heading Defensive Shields, twelve more; they are given here as printed.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
